variants.prediction: Recorded 2026-09-24 after Delta attribution job 22354907, before coalescing tests. The trace shows 62-75 pending heap-drain callbacks on four sampled PEs (median 14-17 at execution), because each controller round injects an additional self-rescheduling drain chain. ACIC_COALESCE_HEAP reuses the existing callback on the shared-heap path; thresholds, slice size, batching and relaxation rules stay fixed. Predictions: pending heap callbacks fall to at most one; same-process controller callback p90 delay falls by at least 25%; road production speedup over frozen 1.05-1.20, work within 20%; mesh speedup at least 0.95 and within repeated-control noise if below 1. All source digests and work ledgers must pass. Two training sources, one warmup and three timed launches, old scheduler on every arm. This first allocation selects; no acceptance without a second allocation and held-out confirmation. Repeat at 8 nodes only after the one-node and distributed correctness gates.

caveats: Road traces are diagnostic runs, not additional production timings; their ratio is not an accepted performance result.
Road production data came from 22355092; this continuation adds 40 mesh solves and two road trace solves. Its 80-solve audit includes those 40 retained road solves.
